initialize_assets.name: Initialize assets

overwrite.name: Overwrite managed files
overwrite.description: Update bundled files that already exist.

reinstall_assets.description: Force reinstall the bundled Theme Studio files. User themes are never overwritten.

save_preset.name: Save user theme
save_preset.description: Save the editor values as a user theme.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Theme name, active variant and the light/dark settings.

delete_user_theme.name: Delete user theme
delete_user_theme.description: Delete a user theme and its built theme file.

build_theme.name: Build theme
build_theme.description: Export a preset or user theme as a Home Assistant theme with light and dark mode.

name.description: Preset or user theme to build.

export_user_theme.name: Export user theme
export_user_theme.description: Write a user theme to /config/www/theme_studio/exports and return it as JSON and as a share string. A notification links to the file.

import_user_theme.name: Import user theme
import_user_theme.description: Create a new user theme from JSON or a share code. Without data, every .json/.txt file in /config/theme_studio/imports is imported. Existing user themes are never overwritten; a name that is taken gets a number.

data.name: Data
data.description: Exported JSON or a share string starting with TS1:.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for the new user theme. Defaults to the name in the data.

theme_from_image.name: Theme from image
theme_from_image.description: Create a new user theme with a light and a dark variant from the colours of a background image and check its contrast. Nothing existing is changed.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the new user theme. Defaults to 'From' followed by the image name.

not_loaded.message: Theme Studio is not set up.

invalid_payload.message: The payload must be an object with the theme settings.

classic_dashboard_removed.title: Theme Studio: restart to finish removing the old dashboard
classic_dashboard_removed.description:
Theme Studio 1.0 no longer has the YAML dashboard, its package or the theme Theme Studio Dynamic; everything is done in the Theme Studio panel in the sidebar. These files were renamed with a .bak_ ending and the date, so they no longer load: {files}.

Restart Home Assistant to unload the old scripts, automations and template sensors. If a dashboard or your profile used the theme Theme Studio Dynamic, choose another theme, for example Theme Studio Standard. Your user themes were not changed.

classic_dashboard_configured.title: Theme Studio: remove the old dashboard from configuration.yaml
classic_dashboard_configured.description: `configuration.yaml` still adds the Theme Studio dashboard (`theme_studio_dashboard.yaml`), which was removed in Theme Studio 1.0. Delete the `theme-studio` block under `lovelace: dashboards:` and restart Home Assistant. This message goes away by itself afterwards.
